verses.text: Ayik wan spechji b'eyek' winhaj David yuj winhaj Saúl yuninal winhaj Cis, ay jun nhilanh heb' winh jelan yak'an owal ix b'at yak'och sb'a yet' winh t'a Siclag.

Ha juntzanh heb' winh soldado chi' ay sjul-lab' heb' winh yet' ch'anh smejmeech yet'nak. Syal sjulwaj heb' winh t'a schab'il sk'ab'. Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi' ay heb' winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' winhaj Saúl t'a yinhtilal Benjamín. Haton heb' winh tik:

Ha winhaj Ahiezer sat yajal yaj winh yet' winhaj Joás yuk'tak winh, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Semaa aj chonhab' Gabaa, winhaj Jeziel yet' winhaj Pelet, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Azmavet, winhaj Beraca yet' winhaj Jehú aj chonhab' Anatot heb' winh,
winhaj Ismaías aj Gabaón. Ha jun winh tik ayoch winh stz'akub'ok heb' winh 30 b'inajnak, yajal yaj pax winh t'a heb' winh, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Jahaziel, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Jozabad aj Gedera,
winhaj Eluzai, winhaj Jerimot, winhaj Bealías, winhaj Semarías, winhaj Sefatías aj chonhab' Haruf,
winhaj Elcana, winhaj Isías, winhaj Azareel, winhaj Joezer yet' winhaj Jasobeam, yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Coré,
winhaj Joela yet' winhaj Zebadías heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jeroham aj chonhab' Gedor.

Ay pax juntzanh heb' winh yinhtilal Gad ix b'at yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj David chi' ayik ayek' winh t'a k'een nhak'een t'a tzinan lu'um. Ha juntzanh heb' winh chi' te jelan heb' winh, k'ayb'ab'il yuj heb' winh yak'an owal, yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab' heb' winh yet' k'een slanza. Te ow sat heb' winh icha nok' choj. Te jelan sb'ey heb' winh icha sb'ey nok' k'ultakil chej.

Ha sb'i heb' winh tik t'a stzolal, schael t'a winh b'ab'el masanto t'a winh yuxluchil: Winhaj Ezer, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Mismana, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Atai, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Elzabad, winhaj Jeremías yet' winhaj Makbanai.

Haton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a skal juntzanh heb' winh yinhtilal Gad chi'. Ha junok winh kennhej yopisio t'a skal heb' winh, yajal winh t'a junok 100 soldado, haxo junok winh niwan yopisio, yajal yaj winh t'a junok mil soldado.

Haton heb' winh ix k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán t'a b'ab'el uj t'a yol ab'il, ayik ix te k'e ha', wan yel ha' t'a stitak b'aj sb'eyi. Ha heb' winh ix pechanel heb' anima kajan t'a ak'lik ay t'a sk'axepaltak ha'.
Hanhejtona' ay pax juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Benjamín yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Judá ix k'och yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj David t'a k'een nhak'een chi'.

Ix elta winhaj David chi' scha heb' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Tato t'a junk'olal tzex jawi, yik tzex kolwaj wet'ok, tzex in cha t'a smasanil in k'ool, palta tato tzex jawi yik tzin eyak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' wajk'ol jun, wach'chom malaj junok tas chuk ix in k'ulej, aokab' ko Diosal, haton sDiosal heb' ko mam kicham ol yil sb'a heyet'ok, syak'anoch eyaelal, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winhaj Amasai yajalil heb' winh 30 soldado b'inajnak, yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Skak' wal och ko b'a het'ok ach David yuninal winhaj Isaí. Ha ach tik yet' heb' ayoch het'ok, wach'nhej ol aj eyelk'ochi, yujto a ko Diosal skolwaj wal het'ok, xchi winh t'a winhaj David chi'. Yuj chi' ix chaji heb' winh yuj winhaj David chi', ix ak'ji yopisio heb' winh t'a skal heb' winh yajalil heb' winh soldado chi' yuj winh.

Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' winh soldado yinhtilal Manasés, ix och heb' winh yet' winhaj David chi' ayik ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh filisteo yak' owal yet' winhaj Saúl yalani. Haxo ix smolb'an sb'a heb' winh yajalil heb' filisteo chi', ix yalan heb' winh to max yal-laj sb'at winhaj David chi' yet' heb' winh, yuj chi' ix schek meltzaj winh heb' winh t'a Siclag. Yujto ix yal heb' winh icha tik: Haxo talaj tz'aji, a yet' winhaj Saúl syak'och sb'a winh, yujto yajal winhaj Saúl chi' winh, a onh xo tzonh smilcham winh t'a skal owal chi', xchi heb' winh.

Ayik wan sjaxkan winhaj David t'a Siclag chi', hata' ix k'och heb' winh yinhtilal Manasés chi' yik syak'och sb'a heb' yet' winh, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Adnas, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Jediaiel, winhaj Micael, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Eliú yet' winhaj Ziletai. Yajal yaj heb' winh t'a junjun mil soldado t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Manasés chi'.

Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix kolwaj yet' winhaj David chi' ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' jun nhilanh heb' soldado elk'um yujto te jelan heb' smasanil t'a owal. Ix och heb' winh yajalilok heb' winh soldado winhaj David chi'.
Junjun k'u sq'uib' sb'isul heb' winh soldado ix yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj David chi'. Te niwan heb' winh, te ay pax smay heb' winh.

Ha sb'isul juntzanh soldado te jelan ix k'och t'a winhaj David t'a Hebrón yik tz'ak'jikanoch winh reyal sk'exulok heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl yuj heb' winh, icha ix aj yalan Jehová, haton heb' winh tik:
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Judá, ay 6 mil 800 soldado yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab', yet'nak pax slanza heb' winh, lista yaj heb' winh yak'an owal.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Simeón, ay 7 mil 100 heb' winh soldado tek'an.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví, ay 4 mil 600 heb' winh soldado.
Ay pax 3 mil 700 t'a yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, a winhaj Joiada ayoch yajalilok heb' winh.
Ha winhaj Sadoc kelem winh, te tek'an winh t'a owal. Ay 22 heb' sk'ab'yok winh, yajal yaj heb' winh, ajun heb' winh yet' winh.

Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, haton heb' sk'ab'yok winhaj Saúl, ay 3 mil heb' winh soldado ix k'och yet' winhaj David chi'. Ayik mantzak uji jun tik, ken manh masanilok heb' ayoch yet' heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Efraín, ay 20 mil 800 heb' winh soldado te tek'an, te b'inajnak heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a nanhal heb' yinhtilal Manasés, ay 18 mil heb' winak ix chekjikoti yik tz'ak'jikanoch winhaj David reyal.

Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Isacar, ix jawi 200 heb' winh yajal yet' pax masanil heb' winh soldado ayoch t'a yalanh smandar heb' winh. Ha juntzanh heb' winh winak tik, snachaj wal el yuj heb' winh tas smoj sk'ulej chonhab' Israel.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Zabulón, ay 50 mil heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal, syalnhej sk'anan masanil yamk'ab' yik owal heb' winh, b'ekan sk'ool heb' winh skolwaj yet' winhaj David chi'.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ay mil heb' winh yajal yaji yet' 37 mil heb' winh soldado yet'nak slanza yet' smaklab' jul-lab'.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Dan, ay 28 mil 600 heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Aser, ay 40 mil heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal.

Haxo t'a heb' ay t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, ay 120 mil heb' winh soldado t'a yinhtilal Rubén, t'a yinhtilal Gad yet' pax t'a nanhalxo yinhtilal Manasés. Ha heb' winh chi' tz'akan yaj heb' winh yet' masanil syamk'ab' yik owal.

Ha masanil juntzanh heb' winh soldado tik, ix ja heb' winh t'a Hebrón ayik ix yak'ankanoch winhaj David heb' winh sreyalok chonhab' Israel. Hanhejtona' juntzanhxo heb' yetisraelal heb', junxonhej ix aj spensar heb' smasanil.
Oxe' k'ual ix ek' heb' yet' winhaj David chi' ta'. Ix wa heb', ix yuk'an ha' heb', yujto a heb' yetchonhab' heb' ix ak'an jantak tas ix swa heb' chi'.

Masanil heb' kajan t'a slak'aniltak chi' yet' heb' kajan t'a najat, icha heb' yinhtilal Isacar, heb' yinhtilal Zabulón yet' heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ix yik'kot wael heb' kuchb'il yuj nok' b'uru, nok' kamello, nok' mula yet' pax nok' wakax. Tzijtum makanhil wael ix yik'kot heb', icha ixim harina, takinh higo, takinh uwa, wino, akeite, nok' wakax yet' nok' kalnel. Te niwan tas tz'ab'laj ix yik'kot heb', yujto manhxo jantakok tzalajk'olal t'a Israel chi'.
